title: Capri Holdings Ltd 8-K Filing — Departure of Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer
summary: Capri Holdings Ltd filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026 disclosing that Krista McDonough, Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, voluntarily resigned effective June 26, 2026 to pursue another opportunity. The company has initiated a search for her successor.
key_points: Krista McDonough, Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, submitted voluntary resignation on April 6, 2026
Reason stated: pursuing another professional opportunity
Company has initiated successor search process
Signed by Tyler Reddien, EVP, CFO & COO
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance disclosure regarding a single executive departure. It has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The archive focuses on market structure and macro catalyst content; this filing does not meet those criteria.
